Interior cabinet placement requires Open of the addressed drawer region; interior microwave placement requires Open of the microwave object. Exterior top surfaces require no opening.
Registered objects and region names come from complete scene declarations, not the instruction target. Abstract table fixtures are not direct On/In predicate targets; use their registered regions.
